product.name: Expent Vendor Lifecycle Management
product.description: A platform that manages the entire vendor lifecycle from sourcing to renewals, centralizing vendor and purchase request intake, approvals, and contract management.

product.name: Vendor Selection
product.description: A tool to streamline vendor evaluation and onboarding using RFx and Proof of Concept processes with expert-developed templates.

product.name: Procurement Management
product.description: Centralizes vendor and purchase request intake, tracks unmanaged spend, and automates purchase approval workflows involving relevant stakeholders.

product.name: Risk Management
product.description: Assesses, tracks, and manages vendor risk using AI to evaluate security posture and maintain a risk register.

product.name: Performance Management
product.description: Visualizes and tracks vendor performance using surveys, dashboards, and usage analytics to collect feedback and monitor vendor relationships.

product.name: Contract Management
product.description: Manages vendor contracts and invoices by extracting key data fields using AI and storing them in vendor records for easy access.
